item.title: Science Café (Apr 16, 2026)
item.description: Grab a bite from the Daily Planet Café and join host Chris Smith for our monthly Science Café. Gather with other curious minds at this after-hours event for an informal presentation and conversation about current science topics with guest experts. The Daily Planet Café is open 5–8pm with a full menu during the Science Café. Details on this month’s speaker coming soon! Please copy the URL below to share this page!
